# Architecture Plan — story-0062-0001

**Story:** story-0062-0001 — Parametrizar BASELINE_DIR nos audit scripts  
**Scope:** SIMPLE (shell scripts only, no Java)  
**Generated by:** x-story-implement Phase 1 (inline, SIMPLE scope)

## Architecture Overview

Pure shell parametrization. No architectural components added. 6 existing audit scripts receive an environment variable indirection (`BASELINE_DIR`) for their baseline file directory.

## Component Diagram

```
BASELINE_DIR (env var, default: "audits")
       ↓
audit-baseline-immutability.sh
audit-execution-integrity.sh
audit-pr-evidence.sh
audit-phase-gates.sh
audit-task-hierarchy.sh
setup-branch-protection.sh
       ↓
*.txt files at $BASELINE_DIR/
```

## Design Decisions

- Default `audits/` preserves backward compat (no CI breakage on existing workflows)
- Override via env var follows Unix convention (no config file needed)
- Pattern consistent with `REPO_ROOT`, `BASELINE_CUTOFF_SHA` already in these scripts
